_comment: Per-structure review findings for the exported set (AI-assisted visual review of the Slicer overlays plus the quantitative checks; not a clinical validation).

kept.trachea: Air column from the lower cricoid border to the carina and into both main bronchi, which are cut by the lower scan boundary. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label (before corrections). Corrected: HU mask removed 3.1 % of voxels; 0.96 mL of unlabeled lumen at the larynx seam added.
kept.larynx_air: Hourglass lumen from just above the hyoid to the lower cricoid border; narrowest (98 mm2) inside the thyroid cartilage at about the level of the glottis. Corrected: HU mask removed 16.7 % (boundary voxels that were not air).
kept.hypopharynx: The model's class is a region: 53.7 % of its voxels were not air (collapsed post-cricoid lumen and mucosa). After the HU mask it is the retro-laryngeal air crescent with both piriform sinuses (7.3 -> 3.4 mL). Largest correction in the set.
kept.oropharynx: Air column from the level of the hard palate down to the hyoid level. Corrected: HU mask removed 20.0 %.
kept.nasopharynx: Air space behind the choanae, above the soft palate. Corrected: HU mask removed 7.8 %.
kept.thyroid_cartilage: Both laminae with superior and inferior horns; partly ossified (mean 149 HU, p95 306). Laminae are about 3 mm thick = 2 published voxels, so the outline is approximate. One 60-voxel island removed.
kept.cricoid_cartilage: Complete ring: tall posterior lamina, low anterior arch. Not ossified (116 HU); its border relies on about 60 HU contrast against muscle and looks slightly thick. Lies at the C6-C7 level.
kept.hyoid: Body and both greater horns, lesser horns as small bumps (410 HU); lies at the C4 level.
kept.teeth_upper: Maxillary dentition as one merged body; single teeth are not separable at 1.5 mm. Front teeth border the publisher-blurred zone.
kept.teeth_lower: Mandibular dentition as one merged structure in three parts (front arch and two posterior groups); single teeth are not separable at 1.5 mm. Front teeth border the publisher-blurred zone.
kept.mandible: Complete, including both condyles and coronoid processes; teeth are separate structures.
kept.hard_palate: Bony palate, about 2.9 mm thick (2 published voxels). Lies inside the skull mask, which gives it up (overlap rule). Its slice label is 19 % larger than the mask because of the 1.5 mm grid.
kept.vertebrae_C1: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.93 against the publisher's label. Note: ring without a body.
kept.vertebrae_C2: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label. Note: dens visible.
kept.vertebrae_C3: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.95 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_C4: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.95 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_C5: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.95 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_C6: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.95 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_C7: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.95 against the publisher's label. Note: long spinous process.
kept.vertebrae_T1: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_T2: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_T3: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label.
kept.vertebrae_T4: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label. Note: tip of the spinous process touches the posterior image border (132 border voxels).
kept.vertebrae_T5: Body, arch and processes follow the bone; level counted down from C1 and C2. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label. Note: tip of the spinous process touches the posterior image border (69 border voxels); one 14-voxel island removed.
kept.rib_left_1: First rib. Its head ends 5.5 mm from T1 (rib heads are a known shortfall of the model) and its anterior end 12 mm from the manubrium (costal cartilage not exported); 75 voxels touch the left image border. Dice 0.91 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.rib_right_1: First rib; its head is 2.2 mm from T1 and its anterior end 13 mm from the manubrium (costal cartilage not exported). Dice 0.92 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.clavicula_left: Only the medial 58 mm is inside the scan: cut flat by the left image border (2.1 cm2 cut face). Kept because the sternoclavicular end is the landmark. Dice 0.92 against the publisher's label.
kept.clavicula_right: Only the medial 62 mm is inside the scan: cut flat by the right image border (2.7 cm2 cut face). Kept because the sternoclavicular end is the landmark. Dice 0.92 against the publisher's label.
kept.sternum: Manubrium and the start of the body (51 mm); cut by the lower scan boundary. Dice 0.90 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.skull: craniofacial_structures skull (separate from the mandible), cut at the exhibit's upper boundary S = 303.34 mm: skull base, maxilla, lower zygomatic bones, mastoid and occipital parts only. Includes air cells (p5 -364 HU) where thin bone is not resolved. Hard palate and a 9-voxel overlap with C1 subtracted; fragments left by the cut removed.
kept.aorta: Aortic arch; both limbs cut by the lower scan boundary. Enhancing (160 HU, arterial-late phase). Dice 0.97 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.brachiocephalic_trunk: From the arch to its bifurcation in front of the trachea (137 HU). Dice 0.93 against the publisher's label.
kept.common_carotid_artery_left: From the aortic arch to the carotid bifurcation, 142 mm long, about 6 mm calibre = 4 published voxels (152 HU). The model's mask stopped 13.5 mm below the internal carotid mask; the plainly enhanced segment in between (distal common carotid and carotid bulb, 175 HU) was added (+0.87 mL). Its top 2-3 mm may already be past the bifurcation. Dice 0.87 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.common_carotid_artery_right: From the brachiocephalic bifurcation to the carotid bifurcation, 114 mm long (156 HU). The model's mask stopped 13.5 mm below the internal carotid mask; the plainly enhanced segment in between (distal common carotid and carotid bulb, 180 HU) was added (+0.82 mL). Its top 2-3 mm may already be past the bifurcation. Dice 0.85 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.internal_carotid_artery_left: From just above the bifurcation to the skull base; 3-4 mm calibre = 2-3 published voxels, so the calibre is approximate (180 HU). The external carotid artery is not a class and is missing.
kept.internal_carotid_artery_right: From just above the bifurcation to the skull base; 3-4 mm calibre = 2-3 published voxels, so the calibre is approximate (182 HU). The external carotid artery is not a class and is missing.
kept.subclavian_artery_left: Arch over the lung apex; its lateral end stops at the left image border. Dice 0.92 against the publisher's label.
kept.subclavian_artery_right: Arch over the lung apex; its lateral end stops at the right image border. Dice 0.93 against the publisher's label.
kept.internal_jugular_vein_left: In two parts with an 8 mm gap at the C7 level (S 146-154 mm in frame G): the vein is only weakly opacified (81 HU against 57 HU in muscle) and cannot be traced there at 1.5 mm. The gap was NOT bridged; the mesh shows it. Its lower end is 7.7 mm from the brachiocephalic vein mask.
kept.internal_jugular_vein_right: Continuous from the skull base down to the root of the neck, where it ends 3.4 mm from the brachiocephalic vein mask (the venous angle and the subclavian vein are not classes). Weakly opacified (80 HU), so the border relies on fat planes.
kept.brachiocephalic_vein_left: Crosses in front of the arch branches to the superior vena cava; almost unopacified (57 HU), so the border relies on fat planes. Its ends do not touch the internal jugular (7.7 mm) or the right brachiocephalic mask (4.0 mm). Dice 0.90 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.brachiocephalic_vein_right: Short vertical trunk into the superior vena cava (135 HU); its upper end is 3.4 mm from the internal jugular mask. Dice 0.94 against the publisher's label before corrections.
kept.superior_vena_cava: Upper part only; cut by the lower scan boundary. Dice 0.96 against the publisher's label.
kept.thyroid_gland: Both lobes, enhancing (118 HU). The isthmus is not resolved, so the gland appears as two separate bodies (54 % and 46 % of the volume). Dice 0.93 against the publisher's label.
kept.submandibular_gland_left: Ovoid gland under the mandible; only about 20 HU contrast to its surroundings, so the border is approximate.
kept.submandibular_gland_right: Ovoid gland under the mandible; only about 16 HU contrast to its surroundings, so the border is approximate.
kept.esophagus: Collapsed tube behind the trachea, left of the midline; cut by the lower scan boundary. Dice 0.94 against the publisher's label.
kept.spinal_cord: The mask fills the spinal canal (about 170 mm2 in cross-section): it is the thecal sac with the cord, not the cord alone. Display name changed accordingly. Cut by the lower scan boundary. Dice 0.94 against the publisher's label.
kept.tongue: Body of the tongue; ends 11 mm above the hyoid and 5 mm from the mandible (floor-of-mouth muscles are not classes). The tip borders the publisher-blurred zone.
kept.soft_palate: Soft palate with uvula between nasopharynx and oral cavity. Two voxels overlapping the skull removed.
kept.sternocleidomastoid_left: From the mastoid region (2 mm from the skull mask) to 2.7 mm above the clavicle and 10.5 mm from the sternum; tendons and attachments are not segmented. Has a through-notch at the C3 level (S 213-232 mm in frame G) around air-density pockets in the left upper lateral neck that open to the skin; the mask follows the image there and was not altered.
kept.sternocleidomastoid_right: From the mastoid region (2 mm from the skull mask) to 2.4 mm above the clavicle and 5.6 mm from the sternum; tendons and attachments are not segmented. No defect seen.
kept.anterior_scalene_left: Runs from the cervical transverse processes towards the first rib and ends 2.6 mm above it (attachments are not segmented); the border with the middle scalene relies on a thin fat plane.
kept.anterior_scalene_right: Runs from the cervical transverse processes towards the first rib and ends 3.3 mm above it (attachments are not segmented); the border with the middle scalene relies on a thin fat plane.
kept.middle_scalene_left: Behind the anterior scalene; ends 3.1 mm above the first rib; borders rely on thin fat planes.
kept.middle_scalene_right: Behind the anterior scalene; ends 2.6 mm above the first rib; borders rely on thin fat planes.
kept.levator_scapulae_left: Upper and middle part; the lower end is cut by the left image border (4.8 cm2 cut face). The scapular insertion is outside the scan on both sides.
kept.levator_scapulae_right: Upper and middle part; ends inside the scan without touching the border. The scapular insertion is outside the scan.
kept.prevertebral_left: Longus colli and capitis as one strap on the front of the vertebral column from the skull base to the T2-T3 level.
kept.prevertebral_right: Longus colli and capitis as one strap on the front of the vertebral column from the skull base to the T2-T3 level.
kept.sterno_thyroid_left: Strap 3-3.6 mm thick (2 published voxels) with almost no HU contrast to its neighbours; probably includes the sternohyoid. Position between sternum and thyroid cartilage is plausible. Lowest confidence of the exported set.
kept.sterno_thyroid_right: Strap 3-3.6 mm thick (2 published voxels) with almost no HU contrast to its neighbours; probably includes the sternohyoid. Lowest confidence of the exported set. 446 voxels overlapping the thyroid gland removed.
kept.masseter_left: Zygomatic arch to mandibular angle; small overlaps with mandible (119 voxels) and skull (168) removed. Its superficial surface lies next to the publisher-blurred cheek zone, so that border is less certain.
kept.masseter_right: Zygomatic arch to mandibular angle; small overlaps with mandible (295 voxels) and skull (179) removed. Its superficial surface lies next to the publisher-blurred cheek zone, so that border is less certain.
kept.medial_pterygoid_left: Medial to the mandibular ramus; small overlaps with mandible (7 voxels) and skull (95) removed.
kept.medial_pterygoid_right: Medial to the mandibular ramus; small overlaps with mandible (33 voxels), skull (167) and submandibular gland (2) removed.
kept.lateral_pterygoid_left: Skull base to mandibular condyle; 140 voxels overlapping the skull removed.
kept.lateral_pterygoid_right: Skull base to mandibular condyle; 128 voxels overlapping the skull removed.
